_: Every job of Juegos de Salón, wherever it runs (D-365). A job that is not here does not exist: jobs.test.mjs fails if a scheduled workflow is missing, and `jobs.mjs install` only installs what is here. `node tools/jobs/jobs.mjs status` shows them all with their last run.

jobs.what: Checks the hola@ inbox without Claude; only when an email is waiting it runs the support agent headless (Haiku) and uploads the reports as issues at once.

Follows the PRs of the lab's 🚀 Publicar requests and, only when the owner asked for a feature to go live from /labs/, runs a headless Claude session that takes it out of the lab and opens its PR with auto-merge.

Every hour, inside the heartbeat (notifications.yml), without Claude: weighs each lab flag's real use by lab key holders (labsUso/) against its threshold and writes flagsListas/, so its /labs/ card says ✅ Listo para 🚀 with the evidence.

Every 5 minutes, inside the heartbeat (notifications.yml): uploads the new 🐞 and email feedback reports from Firebase as `feedback` issues. Each pass also deletes the reply emails left more than 90 days ago without a reply (D-463). `feedback.yml` stays as a manual fallback.

The referee gateway (piece 6 of the learning programme): the one door between the games and the open model on this Mac (Ollama on localhost), kept alive by launchd and reached only through the Cloudflare tunnel. Never the owner's Claude plan.

The heartbeat: each run stays ~5h40m sending the Web Push notifications that are due every 5 minutes and rebuilding Uno al día every hour; the hourly cron queues the next (a relay, D-564, D-565), and each round is measured (rounds and longest gap per Pacific day).

jobs.trigger: hourly inside notifications.yml's heartbeat (D-565); this workflow only by hand
jobs.what: Every hour: rebuilds Uno al día's month of points from the history, with the days a phone's 🧊 saved, and corrects any total that differs, and the week's sums and best streaks, the only writer of them for phones in the night's totals lab (D-500); also writes the season's places by week (uadTemporada/). In the 08 UTC run, deletes the names in stats/ older than 24 months (stats-retention.mjs).

Every day: counts the games finished and the different browsers up to yesterday with the panel's functions and writes only those five totals and their date to controls/traction, which the making-of page reads (tools/firebase/traction.mjs).

Moves finished Cups older than two years (podium saved), stats days older than two years, and daily tables and Uno al día day starts older than 35 days into archive/, copying and checking each one before deleting it. A dry run until the FIREBASE_ARCHIVE_APPLY variable is true.
Saves the podium of every finished Cup, so its champions reach the medal table; since D-499 the app no longer saves podiums, so this is the only writer.
Every Monday recounts the games finished in the last four weeks and, if the order changed, merges a PR with the new home page order, so the 🔥 Popular label moves to this week's top three.
Deletes the expired rooms: sweeps every closed cleanup bucket of a past day, however old, deletes the expired rooms no bucket names and notes the live ones (room-sweep.mjs). Phones no longer sweep.

Opens the "Processes round missed" issue when a commit on main has gone more than a day without the processes round looking at it, and closes it when the round catches up. Also the "Heartbeat behind" issue when notifications.yml's heartbeat stopped or had gaps yesterday (D-565).

jobs.trigger: workflow_run: Tests, End to end (completed, on PRs)
jobs.what: Records every red `tests` or `end-to-end` run of a PR on the `failure-log` branch, one record per failing test with its signature, and closes them when the PR goes green (fixed by that commit, or flaky on the same commit). `failures.mjs check` and `processes.mjs check` show the signatures seen on two PRs.
Keeps the "Pending work" issue current with the open PRs that are stuck and the branches whose commits never reached main and have no PR; closes it when nothing is left.

The processes agent's daily round at 4:30 (the Mac mini keeps Pacific time): a headless Claude session that follows its prompt, launching documentation, usability, support and ideas, handling feedback and collecting the changelog. round-watch checks it ran.
Sunday 8:00: a headless Claude session that runs `node tools/reports/weekly.mjs --send`, the week's PDF emailed to the owner.
Deletes merged, empty and abandoned worktrees at the start of every Claude session in this repo.
Every hour, inside the heartbeat (notifications.yml), without Claude: one comment on each of the owner's PRs left red with no push for an hour, which wakes its cloud session.

Every hour, a Claude Code cloud scheduled task (Sonnet): the contributions agent reviews the outside PRs that changed since its last look and comments what is missing; when one waits only for the owner's Yes, contrib-ready.yml tells the owner. Ends at once when nothing changed.
Every hour, a Claude Code cloud scheduled task: takes over the PRs nudged two hours ago and still red on the same commit, and fixes them on their branch. Ends at once when there are none.

Every day, a Claude Code cloud scheduled task (cheapest model, no repository): archives the owner's sessions of every project that are completed and idle over 2 days, or review-ready or failed and idle over 7; lists those waiting on the owner in a push notification.
